image.$description: The Showrun grade — the brand's image treatment as tokens. Reference implementation: showrun_grade.py in the brand kit; it reproduces the reference plates byte-identically. Three operations, all SUBTRACTIVE — nothing is added that was not in the room. That rule is why every duotone, split-tone and temperature push was rejected: grading against the source is what makes an image look filtered.

saturation.$description: −32%. Sits below the vibrancy clients and agencies use — that gap is the separation.

blackLift.$description: 0–255. Shadows go milky rather than crushed: film, not video. This is why the charcoal ground must sit under 26/255.

warmBias.$description: Red gain against blue. Keeps skin and tungsten honest once saturation drops.

coolException.$value: Available for specific campaigns or stage designs, but must come from natively cool light in the scene — overcast, north window, cool-white LED, blue hour, screen glow. Never from cooling a warm source.

people.$value: Photographed, not generated. Hybrid AI compositing is acceptable for objects and environments only — never for people, and never for anything presented as Daniel's own work.
